maya_cs: Quick heads up  Oakwell Health pilot scheduled Wed 10:00 UTC in eu-west-1. They need an edge allowlist for their partner proxy + a temporary soft QPS window. Also asking to pin model to redwood-med-3-eu during the test. They're still on trial credits so this is a renewal-watch. Ops + SRE: can you advise on capacity? :calendar:
ryan_sre: Can do. What IPs/CIDRs and exact QPS/duration? Are they using streaming (WS) or plain REST? Any KV cache sharing across regions?
maya_cs: Partner IPs: `34.121.2.8/32`, `34.121.2.9/32`. Baseline is ~80 QPS; request is 300 QPS for a 2h window (10:00-12:00 UTC). Expect brief spikes up to 500 QPS lasting ~30-45s. They're using streaming websockets for telemetry. No cross-region KV.
jess_ops: I'll open a provisioning request. Need org id + compliance contact to sign off on IPs. Also confirm region scope (eu-west-1 only?).
maya_cs: Org: oakwell-prod (org_5678). Contact: emma@oakwell.co (eng lead). Confirmed: eu-west-1 only for pilot.
provisioning-bot: Ticket created: PROV-4991 - "Oakwell: eu-west-1 partner-proxy allowlist + temp qps window". Assigned to jess_ops. ETA: 3h.
ryan_sre: Quick capacity check: redwood-med-3-eu can handle a 2hr reserved burst at 300 QPS, but not a long-term commit. I'll add a fallback route to redwood-med-2-eu (slightly higher p95) with automatic failover. Plan: canary 5% -> 100% after 10m if no errors. Also will attach a token-bucket rate policy: soft_quota=300, burst_capacity=500, refill_interval=1s.
leah_account: Marking renewal risk. I'll schedule a post-pilot touchpoint and prepare a usage/cost summary for the follow-up.
pete_sales: I'll join the enablement call and prep a short pre-call note for the customer. @maya_cs please add enablement time.
maya_cs: Enablement requested at Wed 09:30 UTC (30m) to validate integration prior to go. Adding sample curl + WS snippets to the ticket for customer testing:
```
# REST health check
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \\n  -H "X-Org-Id: org_5678" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-med-3-eu","input":"health-check"}'

# WS example (pseudo)
ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream');
ws.onopen = () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({orgId: 'org_5678', model: 'redwood-med-3-eu'}));
```
jess_ops: Provisioning note: will apply allowlist at the edge and create a temporary rate-window rule scoped to org_5678: `soft_quota=300`, `burst=500`, `duration=02:00:00`. Auto-revoke TTL set to `2025-07-01T12:00:00Z`. Rolling to staging for smoke.
provisioning-bot: PROV-4991-STG created. Staging smoke tests queued.
provisioning-bot: PROV-4991-STG smoke tests passed.
ryan_sre: Once approved, I'll push the routing canary and pin policy. Will also wire up monitoring dashboard `oakwell-pilot` with latency (p50/p95), error-rate, and stream connection drops. Alert: >3% stream drops in 10m.
jess_ops: Ready for manual prod rollout on go-time. @maya_cs please confirm 15m before start and we'll flip.
maya_cs: Confirming go-time. Approve production change at 09:45 UTC.
provisioning-bot: Production change applied: allowlist added 2791234588, soft quota updated 2791234589, canary routing live 2791234590. Monitoring dashboard deployed 2791234592.
leah_account: Added CRM note: pilot objective = validate streaming reliability + p95 latency under partner load. Scheduling follow-up call for next day to discuss renewal.
pete_sales: Sent pre-call agenda to Emma (oakwell) and invited them to the 09:30 UTC enablement.
maya_cs: Enablement ran; uploaded notes to ticket. Pilot executed as planned; will share metrics after 24h. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
